prompt: Write a new tale featuring a hardened homebrewer who’s enlisted to lead a raid against beer-thirsty zombies overtaking a once-quiet farm community. Focus on dark humor and survival as he recruits a ragtag team, engineers daring brew rescues, and faces a final showdown in an abandoned chateau turned brewery. Weave in themes of addiction, loyalty, and the absurdity of war. 12,000-15,000 words.
